answer: Divergent-Response Commitments. Each identity must publish a signed answer to a fresh random challenge before seeing any peer's response. Enforcement: a clone sharing the same underlying policy cannot answer differently without breaking its own determinism, so identical responses expose the copied source. Honest agents diverge like a zephyr shifting; clones stay fixed. The check acts as a bridge between challenge rounds, linking responses across time.
